Get a user's access token for another R package

Source: R/session.R
oauth_db_token.Rd

Get the visitor's current access token for an R function that accepts one directly. An access token is a temporary credential for making requests on the user's behalf. The returned function gets a current token each time you call it.

Usage

oauth_db_token(
  authorization,
  target = NULL,
  required_scopes = character(),
  min_valid_for = 60,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

authorization

Function providing the visitor's current sign-in authorization. Pass auth$connection from shinyOAuth without parentheses. To select a saved account, use a function calling auth$connection(id).

target

Name of the service token to use in your shinyOAuth client. Named targets let one sign-in obtain tokens for different services. NULL uses the client's default token.

required_scopes

Additional OAuth permissions to check before use. Request them on the shinyOAuth client first; this check doesn't request consent or grant database privileges.

min_valid_for

Minimum remaining token lifetime, in seconds, when obtaining a token. Use 0 to accept any unexpired token.

session

The visitor's Shiny session. Usually inferred when you create the helper inside server().

Value

A reactive function, such as bearer. Call bearer() inside a render or reactive expression to get the current token string.

Details

Create the helper inside server(). shinyOAuth obtains or renews the token when needed. Call bearer() for each request; a token string saved earlier still has its original expiry time.

For Fabric and Databricks, oauth_db_fabric_api() and oauth_db_databricks_api() can supply credentials to their supporting packages for you.

See also

oauth_db_fabric_api(), oauth_db_databricks_api(). See vignette("getting-started", package = "shinyOAuthDB") for token lifetime.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bearer <- oauth_db_token(auth$connection, required_scopes = "all-apis")
output$rows <- shiny::renderPrint({
  brickster::db_sql_warehouse_list(
    host = "example.cloud.databricks.com",
    token = bearer()
  )
})
} # }
